description: Example FHIR R4 Bundle exported by CellTx Match per case

resourceTypes.purpose: De-identified subject identifier (no PHI by default)
Underlying cancer diagnosis with ICD-10-CM coding
ECOG, biomarker expression (CD19/BCMA/CD20/GPRC5D), lab values with LOINC codes
Cell therapy referral with SNOMED-coded lifecycle stage
Coordinator tasks with priority, due date, assignee
Apheresis → manufacturing → infusion workflow with scheduled periods
Per-event audit trail (every activity log entry maps to one Provenance)
